nodes.label: Product features
nodes.author: PC Master LMS Team
nodes.rationale: 4-in-1 features: LMS, Quiz, Builder 2D, AI chống chặt chém (AI anti-cheating proctoring), plus Career Build and VR mode. Hand-tracking requires a webcam.

nodes.label: Business model & pricing
nodes.author: PC Master LMS Team
nodes.rationale: Freemium B2B2C model: core learning is free; Premium costs 20,000 VND/month for AI + VR. Affiliate commissions (Phong Vũ 3.5%, GearVN 4%, An Phát 3%, Chợ Điện Tử 2.5%) and Sponsored 3D Models from Intel/AMD/ASUS/MSI/Corsair add revenue.

nodes.label: Team & validation
nodes.author: PC Master LMS Team
nodes.rationale: Team: Nguyễn Phúc Khánh Sơn, Đặng Quốc An, Nguyễn Phạm Gia Khiêm, Ngô Minh Khang; advisor Đoàn Thị Kim Phượng. Tested with 76 students of classes 10A1 and 10C9 at THPT Nguyễn Công Trứ; survey NPS 68, 92% understood lessons; won Sản phẩm sáng tạo at Tin học trẻ lần thứ 35.
